title: feat(dispatch-gates): a change to FieldSchema's key set derives the three closure pins outside spec
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x8Be2AAcUBhodBsvnWLd3Xs)_
Fixes #36483
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:这是开发者本地自查清单工具的改动,改了字段定义的键集合时,本地清单会多列出三项该跑的测试。
- 为开发工具链补洞:此前给字段新增键时本地全绿、云端测试却红,两次各白费一轮。
- 出错最多是本地清单多列或漏列这三项测试,云端测试照旧兜底,可随时直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:这是受管的工具文件,需要你审核后亲手合并或入队。

## What changes

A diff that changes **FieldSchema's key set** now derives the three tests outside `packages/spec` that pin that whole set, so the local sweep owes what CI's Test Core shards will check:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run src/builtin-column-collision.test.ts` (FIELD_KEY_STORAGE_CLASS equals the schema's keys, both ways)
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core exec vitest run src/object-schema-fls-references.test.ts` (FIELD_REFERENCE_POSITIONS classifies every key)
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts` (the `field` property count)

How (the card's first arm; the second arm, moving the pins next to the schema, is package code outside this instrument):

- `dispatch-gates.data.mjs`: a new `CHANGE_KIND_ROWS` row `field-schema-key-set` carrying the three tests as package-test subset gates (`ciJob: 'Test Core'`, `ciRunner`, `ciSubset`), the shape of the `spec-migration-entry` precedent, so each goes STALE when Test Core stops running the package test task or the pinned file moves. Each `why` states its measured build prerequisite. New `FIELD_SCHEMA_KEY_DECLARATIONS` names where the key set is declared: `FieldSchema` (second argument of its `strictObject` call) and `MetadataProtectionFields` (spread into the shape). The row's deletion criterion is added to the change-kind list.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs`: the predicate `changesFieldSchemaKeySet` reads the **diff**, like the README claim net: it compares the declaration's top-level members at the merge base (the existing `readReadmeNetBase` reader) with the working tree. Two small readers back it: `objectLiteralMembers` (depth-1 members over `maskCommentsAndLiterals`, spreads kept as one member) and `declaredKeySet`. A created or deleted file, or a declaration the reader cannot find, derives the row (reads wide, never quiet).
- `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`: a new section (40 cases, all fast tier) plus a census line pin moved 753 -> 755 by the two new import lines.

Why diff-read and not a path match on `field.zod.ts`: over the month to a73edb3c, 48 first-parent commits touched `field.zod.ts`. 9 of them changed the key set, and each of those 9 also moved the driver-sql table, which pins the set both ways. Replaying this predicate over all 48 (base = parent, head = commit) fires on exactly those 9. A path match would have named the three suites (and a metadata-protocol closure build) 48 times to catch 9.

### Read first (by risk)

1. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, `objectLiteralMembers`: the depth scan. A wrong member list makes the row quiet or noisy. The live census case holds it equal to the driver's table (87 = 87).
2. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, `changesFieldSchemaKeySet`: the unchanged-file branch returns false, so a surface the PM names before code exists derives nothing (see Acceptance notes).
3. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs`, the new row's three `why` texts: the build prerequisites are measured, not inferred.

### Two-minute verification

Add a line `probeKey: z.boolean().optional(),` to FieldSchema's shape in `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`, then run `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`. Expect 80 commands, the three `vitest run src/...` lines among them. Change only a comment instead and expect 77, none of them. Then `git checkout HEAD -- packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`.

## Tests

<details><summary>Instrument battery and fast self-test, at head 81d3d6618</summary>

- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (detached, per the file header) -> `✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 2313 cases pass; 9 slow section(s) deferred.` `EXIT=0`. On a dev box the gate runs the fast tier by design; CI runs both. The new cases are all fast tier.
- The first fast run before the census fix: `1 of 2313 case(s) failed`. The census pins `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:753 inherited-population`, and the two new import lines moved it to 755. Pin moved with its comment line.

</details>

<details><summary>The three gates run as spelled, green on main (through os-verify-lock)</summary>

- driver-sql, on a tree with **no dist at all** (no build): `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 11 passed (11)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. This confirms "needs NO build".
- metadata-core, same unbuilt tree: `Error: Cannot find package '@objectstack/spec/data'`, `VERDICT command-exit 1`. This confirms it reads the built dist.
- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/metadata-protocol^...' build`: `VERDICT command-exit 0` (1m49s, shared box). Then metadata-core: `Tests 63 passed (63)`, exit 0. metadata-protocol: `Tests 18 passed (18)`, exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Before / after, through the real CLI (mutation via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to HEAD)</summary>

- origin/main a73edb3c, `--commands packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`: `77 command(s) ... 7 by change KIND`, none of the three tests. main's data module names none of the three files (`grep -c` = 0).
- Head, with a FieldSchema key added (anchor 1 -> 0, blob 1539de54 -> da36b936): `80 command(s) ... 10 by change KIND`, and the three lines are present. In the same leg the driver-sql pin reds on the mutant: `unclassified FieldSchema key(s): expected [ 'probeAblationKey' ] to deeply equal []`, `1 failed | 10 passed`. Restored: `blob == HEAD (1539de546d56) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
- Control, comment-only edit to the same file: `77 command(s)`, zero `vitest run src/` lines. Restored the same way.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Dispatch-time asymmetry, deliberate.** At claim time the PM's derivation names a surface before any code exists, so the file is unchanged and the row stays quiet there. It fires in the dev's own re-derivation off the merge base (`--commands` with no paths), and `--ran` reconciliation then refuses a record that is missing one of the three. This is the README claim net's posture. Falling back to a path match is ruled out in the row's deletion criterion.
- **Wider family, not built:** `CARD_PROPERTY_COUNTS` also counts object, flow, page, agent and other types. A key added to `ObjectSchema` (and others) reds the same metadata-protocol control, with no derivation either. The three commits the replay did not fire on (related lists, field groups, a nested column table) were object-key changes of exactly that shape. This row is `field` only.
- **Other readers of `FieldSchema.shape`, measured and not named:** `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts`, `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.test.ts` and `packages/cli/test/data-model-rules.test.ts` check that a key they read is declared, or that one spelling is absent. A new key cannot red them, so they are not this row. The two `builtin-column-storage-attributes.test.ts` files mention `FieldSchema.shape` only in a comment.
- **Reader limits stated:** a comma inside two-parameter type arguments at the literal's own depth reads as a separator, but it never opens a member. A key moved from the top level into a nested schema in the same file reads as a removal, which is the correct answer. Key reorder derives nothing, because no pin reads order.
- **Not measured locally:** the slow tier of the dispatch-gates self-test (CI runs it), `test:repo` (CI-owned).

## Verification

- Derived set on this branch (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, no paths, tree 81d3d6618): 63 commands, matching the dispatch reading. All 63 run locally, each exit 0 (`check:i18n-coverage` first answered exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET; after the build it names, it answered `OK (14 config(s), 585 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)`). `--ran`: `63 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. `check:nul-bytes` OK; `overlap-check` VERDICT clean.
- No changeset: the diff is `scripts/pm/**` only, the root package is private, and no published package's `files[]` lists `scripts/pm`. The `skip-changeset` label goes on with this create (the Check Changeset job wants a changeset or that label).
- Tier H (a governed surface: `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`). Left draft, not enqueued.
